title: Spatial Cloud · Dandelion Collection
changes: Capture a real camera or uploaded image into a large, world-locked 3D photo card; no inference request is made simply by capturing.
Recognized Muse image regions bloom around their source like a dandelion; the results are labeled approximate bounding-box crops, not decoded SAM masks.
Point with Quest controllers or pinch with tracked hands to select, hold and drag images in space; select a card twice to flip its back, or resize and flip with a small edit pill.
Compact dark, borderless spatial toolbar: Gallery, Capture, Muse, SAM, Folder, Bin, Collapse and Exit. Squeeze recenters the empty workspace or flips a selected card.
Collapse/expand a capture cloud on curved paths with brief green particles; captured images and objects remain in the private collection.
Added SQLite captures linked to images and detected objects, persistent relative card transforms, private folders and non-destructive Bin/Restore.
Existing profiles, object inventory, server-stored credentials, quotas and private sharing are preserved by additive migrations.
Billing remains opt-in: Muse and per-object SAM each require a deliberate action; Quest Browser must expose actual camera pixels or a photo must be uploaded.
